# Influence
Influence points on the map are capture objectives that bring the team passive income while you hold them.
## Capturing - To capture a point, stand near it. The more fighters standing, the faster the capture. - Capture is only possible from the [color=#a4885c]Assault[/color] phase — in preparation the points are frozen.
## Mechanics - If both teams have equal forces on the point, [color=#a4885c]capture freezes[/color] until someone tips the balance. - If a point is left empty, progress starts to melt — don't leave captured points unattended. - Once capture is complete, the team owns the point and earns income until it's taken back.
## Reward - The point's owner earns front points on a regular interval, multiplied by the current phase economy. - The point appears on the [textlink="tactical map" link="WH40KTacticalMap"] with a callsign and capture progress.
## Tips - Keep several fighters on the point — capture goes much faster. - Don't leave a point empty — progress drops and the enemy takes it back easily. - Coordinate captures through the tactical map so you don't spread thin.
